t_row_all: Show the log of every app
t_empty: No app of your fortress reports a status yet.
t_engine: The TollRoll service does not answer. Reinstalling the plugin starts it again.
e_engine: the TollRoll service does not answer
s_notify_hint: While a channel is on, TollRoll checks your apps once a minute. It tells you when an app stops answering, when it answers again and when it shows something new that needs you. Each of these is sent once.
s_n_apprise_hint: The address of a key on your Apprise API server, such as http://192.168.1.10:8000/notify/tollroll.
s_n_err_invalid: a field is missing or not valid
n_down_body: TollRoll could not read {name} for a few minutes. The TollRoll settings show why.
n_test_body: If you read this, TollRoll can reach you here.
t_quiet_hint: Reports no status, so it has no row in the tile
t_map_hint: Click an app to see its log.
t_alone: No other device has joined the fortress yet.
t_join_title: Join with the phrase of your fortress
t_join_text: Then every app of your fortress shows up here, with its state and its log.
t_removed_title: TollRoll was removed from the fortress
t_removed_text: Another member took TollRoll out. The phrase brings you back in at any time.
s_live: Every change is saved right away.
s_n_apprise_bad: This is not a web address. It is saved as soon as it starts with http:// or https://.
s_join_hint: TollRoll shows every app of your fortress. You find the phrase in every app of the fortress under Instances.
s_rejoin_hint: If the phrase was changed in one of your apps, enter the new one here. Until then TollRoll cannot read the apps of the fortress.
s_words_hint: Paste the whole phrase into the first field and it spreads out by itself. TollRoll keeps only the keys made from it, never the phrase.
s_phrase_bad: This phrase does not fit. Check for a mistyped or swapped word.
s_removed_note: Another member removed TollRoll from the fortress. The phrase brings you back in at any time.
s_leave_text: TollRoll then stops reading the apps of the fortress. The others see this server as not reachable until someone removes it there.
e_join_failed: TollRoll could not join, try again in a moment
e_leave_failed: TollRoll could not leave, try again in a moment
